architecture.system_overview: Market-style redesign for Kantin Boash web app. Enforces clean white cards with rounded-3xl/2xl, high-contrast typography, crisp portion chips, client-side seller auth modal, zero-emoji UI control policy using inline SVGs, and complete elimination of philosophy/duplicate marketing sections.

agent_lanes.designer: Phase 1.5 & Phase 2: Design direction tokens, clean white cards, SVG icon integration, modal layout, typography hierarchy, responsive spacing, touch targets >= 44px.
agent_lanes.fixer: Phase 2 & Phase 3: DOM surgery to remove #cerita and #lifestyle-banner, wire sessionStorage seller auth gate ('boash_seller_auth'), replace all emojis in controls/badges/stats with inline SVGs, verify live runtime.

motion_lifecycle.entry: Single orchestrated hero fade-in / modal backdrop fade (opacity: 0 to 1, 0.2s)
motion_lifecycle.unmount_cleanup: DOM overlay hidden, body overflow-hidden toggled off

breaking_scenarios.vector: Unauthenticated client visits /penjual.html directly with empty sessionStorage or invalid credentials.
breaking_scenarios.expected_defense: The #seller-auth-modal overlay is displayed immediately, hiding or blocking POS kanban and order mutation buttons. Background polling/order fetching is paused or disabled until 'boash_seller_auth' is set to 'true'.

breaking_scenarios.vector: Automated scan of UI buttons, metric cards, status badges, sound toggles, and modal controls for Unicode emoji codepoints.
breaking_scenarios.expected_defense: Zero emojis present in any UI action, stat, filter, or heading element. Permitted emojis restricted strictly to fallback catalog item food/drink indicators where image assets do not exist.

breaking_scenarios.vector: User clicks navigation links or footer links that previously pointed to #cerita or removed philosophy content.
breaking_scenarios.expected_defense: Navigation links to #cerita are removed from index.html navbar and footer, or safely routed to menu.html without triggering 404 or dead scroll jump.

breaking_scenarios.vector: Accessing login modal on small screen (320px-375px width) with virtual keyboard active.
breaking_scenarios.expected_defense: Modal card fits inside viewport with responsive padding, touch targets >= 44px, and no horizontal overflow.
